status: Preregistered before generation-3 collection; requested 24/36/48-node whole-scene scattering
geometry_revision: dense-rubble-v3; set before generation-3 collection in response to requested obstacle increase

debris_by_difficulty.contact_visibility: Opaque or translucent slabs with collider-aligned outlines; never invisible collision supports

deployment.method: Stratified random positions across the entire modeled scene; random yaw and small pitch/roll; shuffled release order; gravity and collisions determine landing
deployment.anchor_assumption: Commanded release locations are known; only noisy displacement and attitude-derived rays follow. No current true pose is sent.
deployment.limitation: This is a local modeled disaster area. Impact-induced electronics damage and full human body volume are not modeled.

grouping: All three node counts for one scene/world seed stay in the same split. Geometry fusion training leaves out the entire world group, not only one node-count case.
calibration: Instantaneous acoustic and range parameters transferred from the original TRAIN150 only; retained-person classifier and geometry are fitted on generation-3 TRAIN. Historical failed TEST45 is retained and excluded from fitting.
confirmation_gate: Freeze model, binary, five physical/evaluation source hashes, deployment policy, all seed/count formulas and mission budget only after actual VALID passes. Open TEST once; never adjust using its cases.
